scope: Semantic review of a seeded 32-message inspection of the draft retained partition; decisions do not relabel or repair gold. This is not a complete semantic audit of retained data.

decisions.reason: The question asks whether the letter is under one page; gold only asks exists and carries topic, omitting the requested length comparison. The omitted clause is task-relevant.
Team, Press and Jobs are node labels under About, but legacy values_span is mapped to chart.values by the reviewed legacy converter. This source needs correct ownership, not removal of natural names.

The second clause asks to notify the panel; gold mislabels notification as changing the room of all panel objects. Calendar tools do not send notifications. Preserve the first scheduling intent in raw source; do not silently remove the second requested action.
Target kind is annotated article with kind_span timeline, without an owning semantic declaration that identifies a timeline as an article. Gold also omits the explicit topic.
Putting the existing meeting in ROOM 4 is represented as a result room.name on a meeting target. This may rename a room instead of assigning meeting.room; target/constraint ownership requires review.
The source explicitly asks to keep the list, while the annotated deletion has no preservation constraint. This matters because native section removal can remove the heading's entire member range.
